name: Helpers show as minis while they work, and the finished agent as a parcel
case: The agent sends three helpers off, then one comes back, then the turn ends. The screen counts the helpers at work, a mini each (three, then two), and once the turn is over none, and the agent sits idle: one parcel for BOOT.
why: The state's helpers count (Core.snapshot: helpers of every working session) and its idle count (sessions whose turn ended); the line under the face draws them (render/screens.cpp drawStrip, gel lane.cpp strip)
